baseline_anchor.note: Frozen P2 artifacts, read as-is. No re-run, no re-grading.

integrity.gold_label_use: gold (C) is used ONLY to score a selection; it never influences selection. Enforced by test_select_answer_is_gold_independent.

model.name: llama-3.1-8b
model.rationale: Pipelines are system-level interventions; they must be judged on the frozen baseline host/model so any gain is attributable to the pipeline, not to a new model. P3-A (stronger model) remains blocked on the resource decision and is not evaluated here.

protocol.abstention: Recorded, not scored as correct. An abstention is never a false acceptance.
protocol.false_acceptance: Verifier-marked-correct that is actually wrong. ONE false acceptance rejects the track outright, regardless of accuracy.
protocol.p0_p1_envelope: Full suite green, evidence schema PASS, all P0/P1 evidence byte-unchanged.
protocol.r2_closure_rules: Unchanged from frozen repair.run_task: min 2 / max 3 rounds, approvals >= 2 to close. Pipeline additionally applies deterministic ranking and an optional sim/FRM gate.
protocol.r2_sim_stage: Optional. Not-run is recorded as not-run, never as pass.

r2_track.grader: Frozen repair.verify (value_gate + splice + lint wall) — unchanged

status: FROZEN — no spec change after this tag
title: P3 pipeline benchmark — frozen spec (system-level intervention)

m1_r2.repeatability: Reported, not separately gated at N=20; a single-run win is evidence, not proof.

m2_t4.improvement_over_baseline: accuracy >= 0.90 (baseline 0.70; +20pp) — the frozen T4 bar is retained, not lowered

m3_overall.pass: M1 and M2 both pass AND P0/P1 envelope intact
m3_overall.partial: If exactly one track passes: recorded as a partial/track-specific improvement finding. NOT an overall pass. Walls not cleared remain OPEN.
m3_overall.on_fail: Miss recorded as a result. Bar never relaxed to convert a miss. Direction moves to further system-level intervention (structured generation, verifier-guided decoding).

verdict_rules.regression_guard: Suite green + evidence PASS + P0/P1 files byte-unchanged. Violation rejects regardless of accuracy.
